typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	DeltaDate as timestamp (),
	ExportFile as string (),
	ExportFolder as string (),
	FileDate as timestamp (),
	FileName as string (),
	MonthsSincePregnancy as integer (),
	NewDeltaDate as timestamp (),
	OverrideAsOfDate as timestamp (),
	OverrideEndDate as timestamp (),
	OverrideFileDate as timestamp (),
	OverrideStartDate as timestamp (),
	QueryAsOfDate as timestamp (),
	QueryEndDate as timestamp (),
	QueryStartDate as timestamp (),
	RecordCount as integer (),
	SEMExportFile as string (),
	SEMFileName as string (),
	SEMSelectSQL as string (),
	UpdateDeltaDateIndicator as integer ()
}

source(output(
		Data as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'User::SEMSelectSQL',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SEMData

		Data as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Data)) ~> SEMFile
